calls.statement:
SELECT c.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS rows_h, (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS dist_h
FROM dim_campaign c ORDER BY start_date

calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
exp AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM h) AS holdout_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM exp)) AS held_and_contacted,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) AS not_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM exp) AS contacted_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND NOT marketing_consent)) AS now_no_consent
